title: ERP Specialist
minimumQualification: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Technical
jobDescription:
Job Description: We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical ERP Finance Specialist with 3+ years of hands-on experience supporting, implementing, or optimizing enterprise financial systems. In this role, you will bridge the gap between finance business operations and our IT infrastructure, ensuring our ERP financial modules align with organizational goals, compliance standards, and reporting needs. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
System Maintenance & Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day ERP finance module issues (General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, and Cost Accounting). Process Optimization: Analyze existing financial workflows and implement system configurations or automation to improve efficiency and accuracy. System Implementations & Enhancements: Lead or support ERP upgrades, module deployments, and integration projects alongside cross-functional IT and business teams. Reporting & Data Analytics: Design, build, and maintain financial reports, dashboards, and system queries (e.g., balance sheets, P&L, aging reports) to support executive decision-making. Testing & Quality Assurance: Create test scripts, conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validate end-to-end financial workflows prior to system changes or go-lives. User Support & Training: Provide tier-2/3 technical support to global finance teams, create functional documentation, and conduct user training sessions. Compliance & Data Integrity: Ensure system controls, user permissions, and transaction workflows adhere to SOX compliance, local tax regulations, and internal audit guidelines. . Required Qualifications & Skills Experience: 3+ years of direct experience implementing, configuring, or supporting financial modules in a major ERP platform (e.g., SAP, Net Suite, Oracle Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or Workday). Domain Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of core accounting principles (GAAP / IFRS), monthly/year-end closing processes, and financial reporting structure.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Technical Proficiency: Experience writing SQL queries, utilizing reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), or working with financial reporting software. title: Technical Architect
jobDescription: Job Description: We are looking for a high-performing Technical Architect with 2 to 6 years of hands-on software development and system architecture experience. Key Responsibilities Architecture & System Design: Design end-to-end scalable, resilient, and secure software architectures for core products and features. Hands-on Technical Leadership: Write high-quality, production-ready code for core architectural components and complex modules (~30–50% coding). Code Quality & Standards: Establish and enforce best practices, coding standards, code review protocols, and design principles (SOLID, DRY, Clean Architecture). Technology Evaluation: Evaluate and recommend new technologies, frameworks, libraries, and cloud services to improve platform capabilities and developer velocity. Performance & Security: Identify performance bottlenecks, optimize database queries, and implement robust security protocols to protect systems against vulnerabilities. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Dev Ops teams, and QA to align technical solutions with business goals. Mentorship: Guide and mentor mid-level and junior developers, conducting architecture reviews and fostering a engineering excellence culture. Required Qualifications & Skills Experience: 2 to 6 years of progressive experience in software development, with at least 1–2 years involvement in system design or module architecture. Core Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in at least one modern language/stack (e.g., Java, Node.js, Python, Go, .NET, or C++ ). System Design Fundamentals: Good understanding of Microservices vs. Monolithic architectures, RESTful APIs, Graph QL, and event-driven architectures (Kafka, Rabbit MQ). Database & Caching Expertise: Proficiency in relational databases (Postgre SQL, My SQL) and No SQL solutions (Mongo DB, Cassandra, Dynamo DB). Hands-on experience with caching strategies using Redis or Memcached. You will be responsible for designing, integrating, and optimizing billing solutions that support multi-play services, ensuring seamless revenue management and data synchronization. Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture & Integration: Design and implement billing and revenue management solutions integrating Telecom OSS/BSS with Water and Electricity utility billing systems. TMF Standards Application: Apply TM Forum Open APIs (such as TMF620 Product Catalog, TMF622 Product Ordering, TMF678 Customer Bill Management, and TMF632 Organization Management) to standardize data exchange between utility frameworks and telecom platforms. Billing Configuration: Configure and manage complex billing cycles, tariff structures, rating engines, and invoicing for water, electricity, and telecom bundled services. Data Modeling: Utilize the TM Forum Information Framework (SID) to map utility specific attributes (e.g., meter readings, consumption metrics, grid topologies) into standard telecom data models. Process Optimization: Align business processes with the TM Forum Business Process Framework (e TOM), specifically focusing on Order-to-Activate (O2A) and Lead-to-Cash (L2C) cycles for utilities. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Telecom Network Engineers, Utility Grid Operations, Product Managers, and IT Infrastructure teams, to deliver end-to-end solutions. Requirement Gathering & Analysis: Actively engage with clients to capture their exact business requirements, translating complex utility and telecom needs into actionable technical specifications. Technical Advisory: Provide clear technical clarity and direction to stakeholders, breaking down complex TMF architectures and utility billing processes into easily understandable concepts. Consultative Solutioning: Analyze client challenges to propose optimal, scalable solutions that align with both business goals and TM Forum best practices. Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, managing communications effectively to build trust and ensure alignment across all phases of the project delivery. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in the Telecom sector working on BSS/OSS transformations, specifically within billing and revenue management. Domain Expertise: Proven experience handling Utility Billing systems for Water and Electricity (e.g., experience with SAP IS-U, Oracle Utilities, or similar MDM/Billing platforms is a major plus). Technical Skills: * Familiarity with Meter Data Management (MDM) and Automated Meter Reading (AMR/AMI) integrations. Soft Skills: Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. jobDescription:
Job Description We are looking for a seasoned Senior Data Engineer with over 5 years of experience to design, build, and optimize our core data infrastructure. In this role, you will architect robust data pipelines, scale our data warehouse, and ensure that our data systems are highly available, reliable, and secure. As a senior member of the team, you will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to turn raw data into actionable insights, while mentoring junior engineers and championing engineering best practices. Key Responsibilities Architecture & Pipeline Development: Design, construct, install, and maintain highly scalable data management systems and end-to-end ELT/ETL pipelines. Data Warehousing & Modeling: Optimize data environments (e.g., Snowflake, Big Query, Redshift) and design efficient data models (Star/Snowflake schemas) for complex datasets. Performance Tuning: Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipeline performance, ensuring low latency and cost-effective cloud resource utilization. Data Governance & Security: Implement data quality checks, data masking, and access controls to ensure strict compliance with security and privacy standards. Dev Ops & Automation: Integrate CI/CD practices into data engineering workflows and manage infrastructure as code (Ia C) where applicable. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in data engineering or back-end software engineering with a heavy focus on data infrastructure.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Programming Languages: Expert-level proficiency in Python , SQL , and familiarity with Scala or Java. Big Data & Cloud Technologies: * Proven experience with cloud platforms ( AWS, GCP, or Azure ). Strong hands-on experience with modern data stack tools like Airflow, dbt, Spark, Kafka, or Flink . Database Expertise: Deep understanding of No SQL databases, relational databases, and columnar storage formats (Parquet, ORC). title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (Node.js / React / AWS)
jobDescription:
Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and collaborative Lead Full-Stack Developer to drive the development of our web applications. In this role, you will be both a hands-on developer and a technical leader, managing a team of engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-centric software. You will own the technical roadmap for your product area, making critical architecture decisions across both the front-end and back-end ecosystems, while fostering a culture of engineering excellence through mentorship and code reviews. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership: Lead an agile team of developers, guiding sprint planning, task estimation, code reviews, and technical design sessions. Full-Stack Development: Architect, develop, and maintain robust front-end user interfaces and scalable back-end services (approx. 60% hands-on coding, 40% architecture/leadership). Architecture & Integration: Design secure, efficient RESTful APIs or Graph QL endpoints, and optimize data schemas for relational and non-relational databases. Dev Ops & Delivery: Oversee automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure seamless software delivery. Performance & Security: Identify system bottlenecks, optimize application performance for maximum speed and scalability, and implement web security best practices (OWASP Top 10). Mentorship: Coach and mentor junior and mid-level developers, supporting their professional growth and establishing best practices across the team. Required Qualifications & Skills Experience: 7+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or mentoring capacity.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). Front-End Expertise: Deep proficiency in Java Script/Type Script and modern front-end frameworks—specifically React.js , Angular , or Vue.js —along with HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design. Back-End Expertise: Strong experience with back-end technologies such as Node.js , Python (Django/Fast API) , Java (Spring Boot) , or .NET . Database & Caching: Proven experience with relational databases (Postgre SQL, My SQL) and No SQL databases (Mongo DB, Redis). Cloud & Dev Ops: Familiarity with cloud infrastructure ( AWS, GCP, or Azure ) and containerization technologies ( Docker , Kubernetes).
